name: SearchResults
title: SearchResults
summary: The in-app search screen: focused field with Cancel, recent searches, results grouped by type with highlighted matches, and a helpful no-results state.
whenToUse: Use when the reader taps search in the AppBar of dot.Bible or another ISM app.
Use groups (Languages, Verses, Pages) whenever results come from more than one source.
whenNotToUse: Do not use for filtering a short list already on screen; filter in place.

anatomy.description: Search bar (`.ap-bar.ap-bar-search`), then `.ap-res-h` group headers and `.ap-res` rows.

variants.pieces: Recent list (.ap-res with clock icon + .ap-rm remove), .ap-res-action Clear, "Try" .ap-chips

states.universal: See rules/states.md for the seven required states and their hooks.

rules: Highlight the matched characters with `mark.ap-hl` (blue tint, `--horizon-blue-dim`, 600). Highlight only the match, never the whole row.
In-app results end with › (drills into an app screen). Results that open the website end with ↗.
Result rows are at least 56px; remove buttons are 44px.
Group order: Languages, Verses, Pages. Counts use `.count` in Horizon Blue, never red.
Show at most five rows per group, then a "See all" `.ap-res-action`.
Recent searches: newest first, five at most, each removable, plus Clear for all.
The no-results state offers one secondary action. No blue primary on this screen.
do: Use when the reader taps search in the AppBar of dot.Bible or another ISM app.

dont: Do not use for filtering a short list already on screen; filter in place.
accessibility: `role="search"` on the bar; the input has an accessible name.
Announce result counts in a polite live region ("2 languages, 14 verses, 1 page").
`mark` is fine for screen readers; do not split words with extra elements.
↗ rows need text that says they open the website (`aria-label` on the ↗ or in the row name).
Cancel returns focus to the search trigger.
content: Language results show the English name, the native name and what is available: "Kiswahili · Bible + audio".
Verse results show the reference and a short snippet with ellipses.
No results: "No results for “xqz”" + "Check the spelling, or try a book name like “John” or a language like “Amharic”." + "Browse all languages".
